steps.title: Theme
steps.content: Switch between light and dark mode. The default follows your browser preference.

steps.title: Translator italics
steps.content: When on, words the translator added are shown in italics, for supported translations such as KJV.

steps.title: Paragraph marks
steps.content: When on, paragraph start markings added by the translator are shown in the verse display, for supported translations such as KJV.

steps.title: Languages
steps.content: Choose which languages appear when browsing and adding translations. Your browser language plus Biblical Hebrew and Ancient Greek are selected by default.

steps.title: Sources
steps.content: Libraries and subscriptions are managed in File Sync → Subscriptions, not here in Settings.

steps.title: User ID
steps.content: Your internal account reference. Support may ask for it if you report an issue.

steps.title: App version
steps.content: The current build version of Marginalia.

steps.title: Copy commit SHA
steps.content: Copies the full git commit for this beta build so you can include it when reporting an issue.

steps.title: Close
steps.content: Close Settings when you are done. Your choices were saved as you made them.
